story: ANSI Art Collection from Old BBSs
text: [LINK] is another great archive for ANSi art. The art scene in the mid 90s was an interesting, vibrant, microcosm, moving from BBS's to IRC over the course of a few years. [VIDEO] and the longer [LINK] are a good watches if youre interested.
